description: List MeteoSwiss Open Government Data stations from a STAC collection on data.geo.admin.ch. Defaults to SwissMetNet automatic weather stations (smn). Other station collections: smn-precip, smn-tower, nime, nbcn, nbcn-precip, obs, phenology, tot. Filter by canton or a name/code search.

canton.description: Canton abbreviation (e.g. BE, ZH, VS, TI).

collection.description: OGD collection alias (default smn). Aliases: smn, smn-precip, smn-tower, nime, nbcn, nbcn-precip, obs, phenology, tot. A full STAC id such as ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn is also accepted.

query.description: Case-insensitive match on station code or name (e.g. BER, Zürich).

name: list_ogd_stations
